stemMd: Which result would most strengthen the recovery interpretation?

options.label: A
options.textMd: Most new users lived in previously unmonitored towns.

options.label: B
options.textMd: Sightings rose at the same long-monitored sites during observation sessions of comparable duration and skill.

options.label: C
options.textMd: The app was downloaded more often.

options.label: E
options.textMd: The submission form had fewer fields.

explanationMd: Comparable sites and effort reduce the main confounding explanation. A rise under those conditions more directly supports an abundance change, though it still does not establish every causal detail.

distractorRationale.c: This supports increased effort, not necessarily abundance.
distractorRationale.a: This expands coverage and complicates comparisons.
distractorRationale.d: Publicity can increase reports without population change.
distractorRationale.e: Easier reporting is an alternative explanation.
